ModMetaData.name: D'thorga Patches
ModMetaData.author: Phobos A. D'thorga
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes and patches for other authors' mods, each switched on only while that mod is active. It copies nothing from them. It replaces D'thorga Vehicle Patches and D'thorga Missile Patches: switch those off when you switch this on.
Harrier VTOL Attack Aircraft:
A realistic build cost: a jet engine, four nozzles, landing gear, fuel tanks, wiring and more, in place of six advanced components and a single engine block. It uses RimThunder's turbine engine when RimThunder is active, and Vanilla Vehicles Expanded parts for the rest.
A fix for the jet failing to load fully when RimPacts is active. The Harrier's flight framework and RimPacts both patch the same Vehicle Framework method, and the way RimPacts does it stops the framework loading most of its patches, including boarding, refuelling and landing. This keeps RimPacts' landing rule working and lets both load.
With Combat Extended, bombs whose ingredients are closer to what they weigh, each built on a stackable steel bomb case of its own (Mk. 82 or Mk. 84), so automated machining bays don't clog. The Drop Tanks upgrade uses Vanilla Vehicles Expanded fuel tanks.
With The Dead Man's Switch and Combat Extended, the bombs and 57 mm rockets can also be made at its ammunition fabricator.
A sortie's map stays open while the jet is flying over it with its pilot aboard, whichever mod made that map. Before, a map from Real Ruins, RimMarket and some others could close under the jet.
RimThunder and The Dead Man's Switch - Expedition:
RimThunder's heavy casting can also be made at the rotary forger, 12 at a time.
Spaceship Turret Hull and Combat Extended:
The armed hull sections load and fire Combat Extended ammunition like any other turret. Hulls already built must be rebuilt to get this.
InterRim Ballistic Missile:
A strategic warhead no longer freezes the game when it lands. The missile mod destroys everything on the struck map in a single frame, which on a large, heavily modded map can run for minutes until Windows closes the game. With this, the blast crosses the map a slice per frame, from the centre outward, and the game keeps responding. Everything the warhead would have destroyed is gone, without the rubble, filth and fragments that made it slow, so a strike now ends in seconds. Overhead mountain shelters what is under it, and settings choose the shelter, rubble, the dead and, with Combat Extended, wall fragments; each that costs speed says so.
The extinction-class warhead now strikes with a shape of its own: a fireball that vaporises the centre and scours the ground, a blast zone where buildings fall and people burn, and a thermal zone where walls stand, plants wilt and fires start. Other settlements in range get the heat and fallout. With Dubs Rimatomics, radioactive fallout, drifting fallout clouds, radiation sickness and flash blindness; without it, the missile mod's nuclear winter. An electromagnetic pulse stops powered buildings.
Needs Harmony and D'thorga Framework. Load it after the mods it patches. It does nothing if none of them is active.
